entries.proposition: The authors call the WWOX CNV the most distinct common CNV-phenotype signal, MAF 47% with 48 contiguous probes.
entries.snippet: the most distinct common CNV-phenotype signal with the highest number of contiguous probes and significant P values was found within the WWOX gene (MAF=47%, 48 contiguous probes for CNV genotypes and 66 contiguous probes in the LRR analysis
entries.anchor: Results, CNV analysis in epilepsy cohorts

entries.proposition: The CNV association is restricted to the SANAD drug-response phenotype.
entries.snippet: This CNV was found to be exclusively associated with the drug-response phenotype in SANAD.
entries.anchor: Results, CNV analysis in epilepsy cohorts

entries.proposition: The genome-wide-strength meta-p sits at chr16:79,043,240, not inside the common deletion.
entries.snippet: in the LRR based meta-analysis the meta-P value was 4.65x10-22 at chr16:79,043,240
entries.anchor: Results, CNV analysis in epilepsy cohorts

entries.proposition: The authors flag the fragile site and ask for validation.
entries.snippet: Since WWOX has a well-known fragile site (FRA16D27) further experimental validation is required to confirm these findings.
entries.anchor: Results, CNV analysis in epilepsy cohorts

entries.proposition: The common intronic deletion spans chr16:78,373,644-78,384,121 at 47% allele frequency in SANAD.
entries.snippet: In SANAD we re-discovered this intronic CNV in WWOX as common deletions with an allele frequency of 47% spanning the region chr16: 78,373,644 - 78,384,121.

entries.proposition: An imprecise, uncited disease sentence restricts WOREE to missense alleles.
entries.snippet: Missense mutations in exons of WWOX have been reported to be associated with highly pathogenic WOREE syndrome in epilepsy, which usually occurs in young children and has a very poor prognosis.

entries.proposition: The methylation cohorts are cancer cohorts.
entries.snippet: Soft Tissue cancer- Ewing sarcoma France (BOCA-FR) (n=107), Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Spain (CLLE-ES) (n=551)

entries.proposition: In SANAD the best drug-response p for the common deletion interval is 1.68e-4 (LRR univariate).
The common intronic deletion is carried homozygously by 1447 gnomAD individuals.
